source_precedence: current Project Intelligence and exact current source

parts.note: eligible means structurally selectable, not independently qualified

preflight_limits: Machine checks shape/lifecycle references, not actual frontend beauty, source auth, release approval or production health
no_go: unwired primary action in release candidate
draft_policy: May contain explicit UNKNOWN and unwired actions; they must remain not-verified, never called live.
release_candidate_policy: Requires positive evidence pointers for actual services, permissions, visual/accessibility test, cross-account denial, independent verdict and exact version. Preflight still requires independent verification.

experience_fields.hero_meaning: plain-language answer: what is this and why does it matter?
experience_fields.empty_state_copy: honest text for when meaningful data is absent
experience_fields.truth_source_ref: ledger/event/dataset reference; static content uses approved source reference, never fabricated events
experience_fields.grid_rule: explicit layout and alignment at usable phone viewport after chrome
experience_fields.touch_state: actual meaningful interaction feedback and disabled/failure behavior
experience_fields.phone_review_ref: external record from actual phone viewport, not a promise
experience_fields.laptop_review_ref: external record from actual desktop/laptop viewport, not a promise
experience_fields.independent_two_second_review_ref: different-seat cold glance and comprehension verdict on the exact version, not self-awarded

experience_policy: Universal on every SCENE in every app. Draft missing entries generate warnings; release_candidate missing/UNKNOWN experience receipts DENY. References alone do not prove a rendered, accessible, functional or independently verified app. Preserve human-only Director cold-open and existing 9/9.5/10 governance decisions; do not silently choose a threshold.
